name: Enest Group Berhad
overview: Enest Group Berhad 今年完成从 LEAP 市场转板至 ACE 市场，并同步进行首次公开募股（IPO），公开发行 116,250,000 股新股。公司业务线未见扩张、缩减或出售的公告，主要动态为上市相关事项。
overview_en: Enest Group Berhad completed its transfer of listing from the LEAP Market to the ACE Market of Bursa Securities this year, accompanied by an initial public offering (IPO) involving a public issue of 116,250,000 new ordinary shares. There were no announcements of expansion, reduction, or disposal of business lines; the main developments were listing-related matters.

segments.name: 集团
segments.note: 今年主要进行转板至 ACE 市场及首次公开募股，未公告业务板块的具体变化。
segments.note_en: The main activity this year was the transfer of listing to the ACE Market and the IPO; no specific changes to business segments were announced.

actions.title: Initial Public Offering
actions.text: 公司发布首次公开募股公告。
actions.text_en: The company released an announcement on the IPO.

actions.title: INITIAL PUBLIC OFFERING IN CONJUNCTION WITH THE TRANSFER OF LISTING OF ENEST GROUP BERHAD FROM THE LEAP MARKET OF BURSA MALAYSIA SECURITIES
actions.text: 公司从 LEAP 市场转板至 ACE 市场，同步进行首次公开募股，公开发行 116,250,000 股新股。
actions.text_en: The company transferred its listing from the LEAP Market to the ACE Market, accompanied by an IPO comprising a public issue of 116,250,000 new ordinary shares.

actions.title: Timetable for IPO
actions.text: 公司公布首次公开募股的时间表。
actions.text_en: The company announced the timetable for the IPO.
